content: markdown-exec renders Python code blocks at mkdocs build time; blocks marked exec='1' html='1' have their print() output captured and embedded as HTML. There is no built-in caching of exec block outputs across builds — each mkdocs build re-executes all blocks. The canonical PYTHONPATH mechanism (export PYTHONPATH=scripts in Makefile) ensures docs_fig and docs_data are importable. Build performance for ~50 pages with figures is typically 30-90 seconds for a full build. Incremental serving (mkdocs serve) re-executes only changed pages. The check_docs_figures.py script catches silent traceback embedding which markdown-exec does not fail on by default.
